title: Saving Jet Fuel
summary: This article explores using scikit-decide library combined with OpenAP for optimizing flight planning to minimize jet fuel consumption. It demonstrates how decision optimization and path-finding algorithms can calculate more fuel-efficient flight routes for airlines.
problem_solved: Reducing aviation fuel costs by finding optimal flight routes through computational optimization
why_valuable: Enables airlines to significantly cut operating costs and environmental impact by mathematically optimizing every flight path
